description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Erf' that provides methods for computing the error function (erf), complementary error function (erfc), their inverse functions, and related operations. It is part of the Apache Commons Math library, specifically in the 'special' package, and contains mathematical algorithms related to error functions.

classes.name: Erf
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for computing the error function, complementary error function, their inverses, and related mathematical operations.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Computes the error function erf(x) using the regularized gamma function, with special handling for large |x| values.

methods.name: erfc
methods.description: Computes the complementary error function erfc(x), also based on the regularized gamma function, with special handling for large |x| values.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Computes the difference erf(x2) - erf(x1) using either erf or erfc for the most precision.

methods.name: erfInv
methods.description: Computes the inverse error function erf^{-1}(x) using an approximation based on rational functions detailed by Mike Giles.

methods.name: erfcInv
methods.description: Computes the inverse complementary error function erfc^{-1}(x), implemented as erfInv(1 - x).
